---
name: project-recover-agent-session-work
description: How to recover uncommitted work from a previous Codex/OpenCode session by replaying apply_patch payloads from the rollout JSONL
metadata:
  type: project
---

When a previous CLI-agent session produced good uncommitted work that a later
session destroyed, the work is usually recoverable from the agent's own
transcript — `.entire/` only stores session metadata, not file contents, and
`git stash`/`refs/heads/entire/*` will not have it either.

Codex rollouts live at `~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-<ts>-<session-id>.jsonl`.
Each `custom_tool_call` payload whose `input` contains `*** Begin Patch` is a
complete apply_patch. Extract them in line order, drop the patches belonging to
the destructive turn, `git archive <base_commit> | tar -x` into a scratch dir,
and replay the rest.

The base commit is in `.git/entire-sessions/<session-id>.json` (`base_commit`).

**Why:** Claude Code's own tools can't see another agent's history, so without
this the only option is re-authoring from screenshots or description.

**How to apply:** Replayer at

**Recovery.** The good version wasn't in git — `.entire/` stores only session metadata. But the Codex rollout at `~/.codex/sessions/2026/08/12/rollout-…-019ff767….jsonl` contains all 31 `apply_patch` payloads verbatim. I extracted them, dropped the final minimization patch, replayed the rest onto `0460b66`, and got back the full 704-line `LandingWonder.tsx` and 1,254 lines of Panda CSS. Everything you named is back:

- **Scrolling side text** — `KineticTeachingText`, three rows drifting at different rates against scroll
- **Mascot message bubbles** — `HeroWonderStage`, clickable, cycling four reactions with the logo badge behind them and WHY? / SHOW YOUR WORK / TRY AGAIN orbiting
- **Cross-legged bot** — the lotus mascot in the journey's Return card
- **Horizontal `LearningJourney`** carousel

**Design changes on top:**

`ShaderField.tsx` (new) — a WebGL fragment shader: domain-warped fBm through a rotated dot screen, with a refresh band sweeping down. Reads as phosphor on dark, print halftone on paper. It renders at ≤0.5 scale on a single fullscreen triangle, pauses off-screen and on hidden tabs, draws one frozen frame under reduced motion, repaints on theme flip, and no-ops without WebGL. Placed behind the hero stage, the kinetic band, and the tape deck.

The video section is one CRT deck instead of two stacked players: four channels (WEB/TUI/CLI/TOUR) on a roving-tabindex tablist, a live VCR timecode and progress bar driven by `timeupdate` written straight to the DOM, scanlines + grain + vignette over the frame, and a burst of static on channel change.

Text cuts: the `run VERSE_PROGRAM` / `open LEARNING_PATH` / `keating help` / `./install.sh` eyebrow pills are gone, the CRT's how-to-use lede and per-frame description paragraphs are gone, and its Previous/Play/Next verbs are now glyphs.

Two bugs that only showed up there: the grain overlay was stuck at full opacity because my `surface-tune` keyframe was lost when I swapped in the recovered Panda config, and the global `break-word` rule was splitting "principles" mid-word in the narrow journey cards. Both fixed.
